facts: The article is devoted to the problem of quantifying noun groups in German.
The results of corpus-based investigations are described.
A thorough description of the phenomena is provided.
The examples underline the necessity of integrating some kind of information other than grammar sensu stricto into the treebank.
A more sophisticated and fine-grained annotation in the tree-bank would have very positve effects on stochastic parsers trained on the tree-bank.
A more sophisticated and fine-grained annotation in the tree-bank would have very positve effects on grammars induced from the treebank.
A more sophisticated and fine-grained annotation in the tree-bank would make the treebank more valuable as a source of data for theoretical linguistic investigations.
Stochastic parsers are trained on the tree-bank.
Grammars are induced from the treebank.
The treebank is a source of data for theoretical linguistic investigations.
The information gained from corpus research are realized in the framework of SILVA.
The analyses that are proposed are realized in the framework of SILVA.
SILVA is a parsing and extraction tool for German text corpora.
